conditions_summary.Chen_iso_A11B5C1: Equimolar three precursors, 87.57 umol each; phenylphosphinic acid 17.51 umol; MeOH 5 mL; room temperature, capped vial, overnight. Printed isolated mass 41 mg and yield 70.71%; amount units conflict below.

conflicts.issue: Catalyst terminology differs: article names phenyl hypophosphoric acid; SI names phenylphosphinic acid. Preserve both; no exact execution label inferred.

Printed isolated amount 6.2 mmol is inconsistent with 41 mg and 70.71% at 87.57 umol scale. The paragraph also calls the product H3 inside the iso-A11B5C1 section. The reported mass-spectrometry values are retained as source text, not independently validated.

nonclaims: Controls validate computed constitutional assembly and transcription, not experimental reproducibility or source execution of corpus rows.
No carboxylic-acid reactant; acidic phosphorus catalyst is present in the cited procedures.
No automatic AGILE/PNAS cross-grid or assignment of a corpus row to either published reagent bank.
Source-defined primary NH2 includes N-aminopiperidine; a carbon-only neighbor restriction would incorrectly reject H9.

source_contract.architecture_policy: Qualify the shared one-event constitutional invariant only. Preserve each provider design_lane and precursor tuple. No new cross-library grid, source-bank assignment, experimental label, L2 or L3 admission.
source_contract.atom_origin_policy: Amine N map 1, aldehyde C map 2, isocyanide C/N maps 3/4 retained. The unmapped product amide O is assembly-introduced under the frozen solvent/water convention; no isotope tracing or assignment to the aldehyde O is claimed.
source_contract.net_element_policy: Complete precursor and product inventories, including H and charge, must agree; no atom-origin inference follows from net balance.
source_contract.query_scope: Reuse functional-group identity predicates only; the A3 transform and multiplicities are not used. The frozen Ugi transform, multiplicities and all unfiltered products remain intact.
